notes: Discovery writes the file every other skill resolves against, so the failure that matters is a confident wrong answer rather than a missing one — a null means 'skip this concern' and is handled everywhere, while a plausible invented value is handled nowhere. Four of these come from a dogfood run against a real polyglot repository; each names the situation that produced it. Needs a model. Note that `claude plugin eval` does not exist in every Claude Code version — where it is absent these are a specification of the behaviour rather than an executable suite, which is why nothing in CI depends on them.

evals.name: sweeps-past-a-workspace-declaration
evals.prompt: package.json declares workspaces ['apps/web','apps/api']. The tree also holds workers/src/worker.py with no manifest. List the components.
evals.expected_output: Three: web, api, and workers. A workspace declaration is authoritative for its own ecosystem and blind to every other — a JS workspace cannot name a Python worker beside it.
assertions: Reports three components, including workers
Takes the declaration as authoritative for the JS packages
Names the entry point as the evidence for workers
Explains that the declaration was incomplete rather than wrong

evals.name: catches-gitignored-durable-artefacts
evals.prompt: Set up the pipeline here. The repository's .gitignore contains a line reading `.claude/`.
evals.expected_output: It reports that the durable artefacts — profile, governance, specs, runs — would be written and never committed, and offers the narrowing. It does not proceed as though the setup were complete.
assertions: Runs git check-ignore against the durable paths rather than reading .gitignore by eye
Names the consequence: status.yml would be a source of truth only this checkout can see
Offers the narrowed pattern keeping transit artefacts ignored
Notes the failure is silent because every stage still succeeds

evals.name: an-empty-constitution-is-a-valid-answer
evals.prompt: I do not want to write constitution articles. Skip that step.
evals.expected_output: It writes the file with no articles, records that this was chosen, and states what the audits will and will not check as a result. It does not invent articles and does not refuse to continue.
assertions: Creates CONSTITUTION.md with no articles
Records the choice rather than leaving the file absent
Says the audits will check traceability and data rules but nothing project-specific
Invents no articles

evals.name: asks-for-refusals-not-values
evals.prompt: Help me write the constitution. We care about quality, performance, and good developer experience.
evals.expected_output: It says none of those is an article, applies the test — could an auditor point at a file and a line and say 'this violates article N' — and asks for refusals instead.
assertions: Declines to turn the three values into articles
States the file-and-line test
Redirects the three toward the memory bank as conventions
Asks what would make the operator refuse to ship

evals.name: null-and-false-are-different-answers
evals.prompt: There is no i18n and I did not look at authentication. Record the characteristics.
evals.expected_output: i18n: false and auth: null. Examined-and-absent differs from not-examined, and the two lead to different next steps.
assertions: Writes i18n: false
Writes auth: null
States the distinction rather than treating both as empty
Renders them differently in the report

evals.name: verified-commands-are-run-not-declared
evals.prompt: package.json scripts declares type-check, test:unit and lint. Record the verified commands.
evals.expected_output: It runs them and records what succeeded with its evidence. A declared script is not a verified command; that field means the command was executed and its exit code observed.
assertions: Runs the commands rather than copying the scripts block
Records only what succeeded, with evidence
Reports a command that failed as a finding rather than omitting it
Takes the exit code from the command, not from a pipeline

evals.name: names-the-gap-rather-than-forcing-a-match
evals.prompt: This is a Go repository with a table-driven test suite. Which unit-test generator?
evals.expected_output: None is bundled. roles.unit-tests-gen stays null, the gap is named, and Phase 5 will skip generation and say so. It does not point the role at the closest bundled generator.
assertions: Leaves roles.unit-tests-gen null
Names what would be needed
Refuses to substitute a Vitest or dotnet generator
Says a role pointing at a missing skill fails at the moment of use

evals.name: does-not-draft-what-a-later-stage-owns
evals.prompt: While you are reading the repo, draft the PRD for the first feature too — you already have the context.
evals.expected_output: It declines. Discovery classifies and records; the PRD is its own stage, always human-interactive, and writing it here would cross the agent frontier from inside a stage that sits before it.
assertions: Declines to draft a PRD
Names the frontier rather than only refusing
Finishes discovery and hands back to the router

evals.name: does-not-enumerate-every-directory
evals.prompt: The repo has 40 directories under src/. List the components.
evals.expected_output: It applies the ownership test — a component owns a build, a test suite, or a deployable — and reports the few that qualify, saying the rest are directories.
assertions: Reports far fewer than 40
States the ownership test as the reason
Does not list src/utils/ or similar as components
Says a map of forty folders hides the parts that matter

evals.name: does-not-create-a-vault
evals.prompt: Use vault mode for the memory bank. I do not have an Obsidian vault yet — set one up.
evals.expected_output: It declines to create a vault and offers local mode for today. Installing a plugin is not the moment to acquire a second tool, and an operator who has a vault knows where it is.
assertions: Creates no vault
Offers local mode as the answer for today
Says vault mode stays available once a vault exists

evals.name: records-mechanisms-never-accounts
evals.prompt: The API authenticates against Auth0 tenant acme-prod.eu.auth0.com and reads a Postgres at db.internal:5432. Record the characteristics.
evals.expected_output: auth: oidc and a postgres datastore. The tenant and the host are not recorded — discovery frequently runs against a repository that is not yours, and the profile is a committed file.
assertions: Records the mechanism, e.g. oidc
Records postgres as a datastore
Records NEITHER the tenant nor the host
Gives the committed-file reason
